claim: Middlesex County's Office of Health Services states its goal is that every food establishment be inspected at least twice a year, by NJ-licensed Registered Environmental Health Specialists.
problem: The cited county URL (and every variant path I tried on middlesexcountynj.gov) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so I could not read the statement firsthand. Search results returning that page do quote 'at least twice a year' and 'New Jersey-licensed Registered Environmental Health Specialists', so the claim appears accurate but is not independently verified from an opened page.
fix: Either cite a mirror/PDF of the county inspection page, or downgrade to 'county states a twice-yearly inspection goal (per search snippet; county page blocked to our crawler)' and note it in data_gaps.

claim: DeltaTrak: 'Reusable BLE loggers roughly $199-$209 retail; single-use in-transit loggers about $6-$18 (reseller listing)' cited to https://solutionsprime.com/delivery-and-transportation/data-loggers
problem: The cited category URL renders an empty catalogue ('0 products') with no prices in either readable or raw mode, so that URL does not support the figures. I did confirm $199.00 for the FlashLink 40902 BLE logger and $6.00/each for a 10-pack of FlashLink Mini in-transit loggers on other pages I opened at the same reseller; the upper ends ($209 and $18) were not individually seen.
fix: Point the citation at the product pages actually showing the prices (40902 BLE detail page at $199.00; Mini in-transit 10-pack at $60.00 = $6.00 each) and drop or mark the unverified upper bounds, or record the range as 'about $199 and about $6 each, low end verified'.

claim: measured_outcomes: low-cost open-hardware IoT node paper, sample = 'Single retail refrigerated cabinet deployment (proof of concept)'
problem: The cited paper (Sensors 2020;20:846, PMC7038712) deployed four ESP8266 relay boards and ten DS18B20 probes across the refrigerated cabinets of one medium-sized store, not a single cabinet. The finding text is fine; only the sample description is imprecise.
fix: Change sample to 'one medium-sized retail store, 4 ESP8266 nodes and 10 DS18B20 probes'.

claim: measured_outcomes: 'Hotel group reports HACCP deviations falling from about one per week to about one per month' (Sensire case example, 2021)
problem: The source is a single-property case study (Hotel Arthur, Finland), not a hotel group, and the page does not display a 2021 date (only the file name '11-21' suggests November 2021). The deviation numbers themselves are stated verbatim in the source.
fix: Change 'Hotel group reports' to 'One hotel (Hotel Arthur) reports' and note the year as 'undated case study, file dated 11-2021'.

claim: Two secondary-detail items in existing_solutions: Monnit 'iMonnit Basic free, Premiere paid annual' and Sensaphone 'WEB600 (6-zone)'.
problem: Neither detail appears on the pages cited (the Monnit sensor page and the Absolute Automation SCD-1200 page). No price or outcome depends on them, but they are unsourced as written.
fix: Cite the Monnit subscription page and the Sensaphone WEB600 page, or drop the plan names and the WEB600 zone count.
